say:1:1029790001:0.text: The tree you planted is so magical and beautiful.
say:1:1029790001:0.source_cn: 你亲手种下的树，是这样神奇而又美丽。
say:1:1029790001:0.male: The tree you planted is so magical and beautiful.
say:1:1029790001:0.female: The tree you planted is so magical and beautiful.

say:2:1029790002:0.text: Time, memories... Even though they might fade, you always manage to make them shine again.
say:2:1029790002:0.source_cn: 时光，回忆……即使一度褪色，但你总会令它们重焕光辉。
say:2:1029790002:0.male: Time, memories... Even though they might fade, you always manage to make them shine again.
say:2:1029790002:0.female: Time, memories... Even though they might fade, you always manage to make them shine again.

say:3:1029790003:0.text: Your journey sounds so exciting. It makes me want to go on an adventure of my own.
say:3:1029790003:0.source_cn: 你的旅程是如此精彩，我也应该早日踏上属于我的旅途了。
say:3:1029790003:0.male: Your journey sounds so exciting. It makes me want to go on an adventure of my own.
say:3:1029790003:0.female: Your journey sounds so exciting. It makes me want to go on an adventure of my own.

say:4:1029790004:0.text: I wonder what this place will look like in a year…
say:4:1029790004:0.source_cn: 来年的此时，这里又会变成什么模样呢？

say:5:1029790005:0.text: I'm looking forward to finding out.
